import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import pytest
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.tree import Tree
from doorstop.core.vcs.mockvcs import WorkingCopy as MockVCS

# Helper to create a temporary Doorstop project structure
@pytest.fixture
def doorstop_project(tmp_path):
    # Create a minimal project root with a documents directory
    root = tmp_path / "doorstop_project"
    root.mkdir()
    (root / "documents").mkdir()
    # Initialize a mock VCS working copy
    vcs = MockVCS(root)
    yield root, vcs
    # Cleanup
    shutil.rmtree(root)

def test_U02_4__Use_Cases_Us__TC_001_store_requirements_in_a_permanent_and_secure_manner(
    doorstop_project,
):
    """
    Verify that adding a requirement creates a file in the project
    and that the file is persisted on disk.
    """
    root, vcs = doorstop_project
    # Create a document
    doc = Document.new(root / "documents" / "doc1.md", prefix="DOC1")
    # Add a requirement
    item = doc.add_item(level="1", text="Test requirement")
    # The item should have a UID derived from the filename
    assert isinstance(item, Item)
    assert item.uid is not None
    # The file should exist on disk
    item_path = item.path
    assert item_path is not None
    assert item_path.exists()
    # The file should contain the requirement text
    content = item_path.read_text()
    assert "Test requirement" in content

def test_U02_4__Use_Cases_Us__TC_002_handle_change_management_of_requirements(
    doorstop_project,
):
    """
    Verify that editing a requirement updates the file content.
    """
    root, vcs = doorstop_project
    doc = Document.new(root / "documents" / "doc2.md", prefix="DOC2")
    item = doc.add_item(level="1", text="Original text")
    # Edit the item
    item.text = "Updated text"
    # Save changes
    item.save()
    # Reload the item from disk
    reloaded = Item.load(item.path)
    assert reloaded.text == "Updated text"

def test_U02_4__Use_Cases_Us__TC_003_associate_requirements_changes_with_developer_identification(
    doorstop_project,
):
    """
    The current implementation does not record developer identification
    for changes. This feature is not yet implemented.
    """
    pytest.skip("NOT_IMPLEMENTED: No API to record developer identity on changes")

def test_U02_4__Use_Cases_Us__TC_004_scalability_to_support_thousands_of_requirements(
    doorstop_project,
):
    """
    Verify that the system can handle a large number of requirements
    without immediate performance degradation. We create a moderate
    number of items and ensure all files are created.
    """
    root, vcs = doorstop_project
    doc = Document.new(root / "documents" / "doc3.md", prefix="DOC3")
    num_items = 200  # moderate number for test speed
    items = []
    for i in range(num_items):
        items.append(doc.add_item(level="1", text=f"Requirement {i+1}"))
    # Ensure all files exist
    for item in items:
        assert item.path.exists()
    # Simple check: the number of files matches
    files = list((root / "documents" / "doc3.md").parent.glob("*.md"))
    assert len(files) == num_items
